name: Carbon
tagline: Pretty code images, no account — the snippet lives in this file.
description:
No account, no tab to lose. The snippet and the theme live in this file, so close it and come back still on the same image. Export a PNG from here. Press Invite in the bar above and a friend types on the same snippet with you — carbon.now.sh cannot do that.

Pick a theme (Seti, Dracula, Night Owl, Nord…), a language, a background, padding, window dots, line numbers. Type or drop a file. The window is the picture.

An unofficial port of Carbon by Mike Fix, Brian Dennis, and Jake Dexheimer. Bugs go to GifOS, not upstream.
